verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical, and both share the same flaws. The sage circle has moved in from its corner, so the SOLSTICE wordmark and the can now sit on top of it. The peach circle rises into the subhead line, and that collision makes the copy look crowded. A spreads the headline, subhead and CTA more evenly down the canvas. B packs that block higher, which leaves a larger empty area under the CTA.
